text:
maria_sales: Hey team — RFP followup from FinTechCo. They want a short, customer-facing summary of how we guarantee data residency for a POC (APAC + EU), plus the exact list of subprocessors by region. Mostly for security review and pricing. Any quick bullets I can send?

alex_presales: I can draft bullets. Quick clarifying q: customer wants tenant pinned to a region or just prefer region-level routing? They mentioned both in the sheet.

maria_sales: Prefer pinned tenant if possible — they want no cross-border processing for PII during the POC. Also asked about BYOK for keys and whether our Dedicated option is needed for that.

josh_engops: For a POC we can offer tenant pinning to a single region (e.g., ap-northeast-1 or eu-central-1) — that pins compute and storage. By default control-plane signals still originate from our control plane (hosted) unless they opt for Private. For BYOK with Dedicated we can integrate customer KMS, otherwise we use our KMS (we can provide attestation).

claire_security: Quick add: for pinned tenants we still have a few subprocessors for networking and monitoring (CDN, infra provider). I'll list those by region, but we need legal to approve sharing contact-level info.

sam_legal: We can share subprocessors list; we should redact support partners' contact details. Also flag: if they require contractual data processing addendum (DPA) changes for APAC subprocessors, that will add ~2 weeks.

alex_presales: Ok — draft bullets for customer email: 1) "Tenant pinning": compute and storage remain in chosen region; 2) "Control plane": management notifications may cross region unless Private; 3) "Subprocessors": list attached; 4) "BYOK": available on Dedicated/Private; 5) "Fallback": automatic fallback to compatible model variant in same region if capacity constrained. Thoughts?

josh_engops: I wouldn't promise automatic fallback to same region unless we've reserved capacity. For a POC we should propose a soft-SLA: prefer same-region fallback; if not available we fail-open to nearest regional pool with audit logs and customer opt-in.

maria_sales: Customer will not accept cross-border processing. They asked for a network diagram showing no egress to outside APAC for the POC. Can ops make that?

josh_engops: I can produce a simple diagram + JSON of routing policy rules. Example snippet for routing policy we can include in the doc: ```
priority: ["ap-northeast-1", "ap-southeast-1"]
route_on_region: true
deny_cross_region: true  # POC mode, requires TenantPin + routing enforcement
fallback_policy: "fail"  # do not auto-fall back to other regions unless approved
```

claire_security: If we set deny_cross_region="true" we must make sure no telemetry or analytics ingesters are in other regions. I'll validate subprocessors: in APAC we use AWS/ap-northeast-1 (EC2/EBS), Cloudflare (edge), Datadog (monitoring) — Datadog can be configured to restrict ingestion to region-specific endpoints for the POC. Need confirmation from eng-ops to reconfigure.

sam_legal: Also add note about subpoenas: if customer needs legal guarantees about third-party access, we should include a short paragraph about our subprocessors' roles and contractual commitments.

alex_presales: I'll assemble a one-pager: bullets + subprocessors table + routing policy snippet + ask for BYOK + optional Dedicated quote delta. Maria, can you send customer that we will follow up with a network diagram and final subprocessors list?

maria_sales: Yep. I'll send a quick note now: "Thanks — we can pin your POC to APAC with strict deny_cross_region routing. We'll send a network diagram and subprocessors list within 48h and a Dedicated price delta for BYOK. Is that timeline ok?"

josh_engops: 48h is tight but doable for a first-pass diagram and subprocessors list (non-redacted). For the reconfig to enforce deny_cross_region end-to-end we'd need 5 business days and an SOW.

claire_security: I'll start the subprocessor inventory for APAC and confirm which Datadog endpoints we can restrict.

ops-bot: Reminder: #oncall-engops assigned josh_engops for the next 48h.

maria_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll reply to the customer and loop legal for the DPA language.
